item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus las gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag po rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po
item.coloph: ces gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag po'i bsgrub (sgrub) pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ smon rgyal kun grol grags pas bgyis pa chu glang zla tshes laM'o//
